mechanism_narrative: Accelerating growth in real GDP signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances following accelerating GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve (10Y-2Y spread) signals a tightening financial conditions that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index signals rising inflation expectations that will drive up discount rates and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating growth in nonfarm payrolls signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances following accelerating payroll growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
